name.ru: Ankle pumps (takhne ko upar neeche karna)

targets: Ankle dorsiflexors and plantarflexors; calf muscle pump for circulation

summary.en: Lying down, pull your feet up towards you and then point them away, like pressing a car pedal.
summary.ru: Let kar paon ko apni taraf kheinchein phir door ki taraf point karein, jaise gaari ka pedal dabate hain.

indications: Reduced ankle movement after injury or immobilisation
Swelling around the ankle or foot
Reducing stiffness during long bed rest
contraindications: Suspected deep vein thrombosis — get assessed first
Unstable fracture or movement restrictions from the surgeon

safety.en: Move gently within a comfortable range — stop if the pain increases.
safety.ru: Aaram ke daayre mein halki harkat karein — dard barhe to ruk jayein.

setup.en: Lie on your back with your legs straight and relaxed, feet free.
setup.ru: Peeth ke bal letein, taangein seedhi aur dheeli, paon azad.

steps.en: Pull your toes and foot up towards your shin.
steps.ru: Panjay aur paon shin ki taraf uper kheinchein.

steps.en: Point your toes away from you.
steps.ru: Panjay apne se door point karein.

steps.en: Repeat smoothly, like pumping a pedal.
steps.ru: Pedal ki tarah aahista dohrayein.

mistakes.en: Moving the whole leg instead of the ankle
mistakes.ru: Takhne ki jagah poori taang hilana

say.en: Pull your feet up towards you.

targets: All ankle movement directions: dorsiflexion, inversion, plantarflexion, eversion

summary.en: Draw slow circles with your big toe, moving the ankle through its full comfortable range.
summary.ru: Angoothe se aahista gol chakkar banayein, takhna apni poori aaram wali range mein hilayein.

indications: Ankle stiffness after sprain or immobilisation
contraindications: Acute ankle sprain that is still very painful or unstable
Movement restrictions from the surgeon

safety.en: Keep the circles slow and pain-free — do not force corners.
safety.ru: Chakkar aahista aur dard ke baghair banayein — corners par zor na dein.

setup.en: Lie back with one leg straight, or sit with the leg supported.
setup.ru: Let jayein aur ek taang seedhi rakhein, ya sahara de kar baithein.

steps.en: Imagine your big toe is a pen drawing a big circle in the air.
steps.ru: Socho ke aap ka angootha pen hai jo hawa mein bara gol chakkar bana raha hai.

steps.en: Make 10 circles clockwise, then 10 anticlockwise.
steps.ru: 10 chakkar seedhi taraf, phir 10 ulti taraf.

mistakes.en: Moving the knee or hip instead of the ankle
mistakes.ru: Takhne ki jagah ghutna ya kulha hilana

say.en: Draw a big, slow circle with your big toe.
say.ru: Angoothe se bara aur aahista chakkar banayein.

name.ru: Calf stretch (let kar, towel ya strap ke saath)

summary.en: Lying down, raise one straight leg and gently pull the foot towards you with a towel or strap.
summary.ru: Let kar ek seedhi taang uthayein aur towel ya strap se paon ko aahista apni taraf kheinchein.

contraindications: Acute calf strain or Achilles tear
Suspected deep vein thrombosis

safety.en: A comfortable pull in the calf only — never sharp pain behind the knee or at the heel.
safety.ru: Sirf pindli mein aaram wala khinchao — ghutne ke peeche ya aerhi mein tez dard nahi.

setup.en: Lie on your back and loop the towel around the ball of your foot.
setup.ru: Peeth ke bal letein aur towel paon ke agle hissay (ball) par daalein.

steps.en: Keep the knee straight and lift the leg.
steps.ru: Ghutna seedha rakh kar taang uthayein.

steps.en: Gently pull the towel so your toes come towards your face.
steps.ru: Towel aahista kheinchein taa ke panjay chehre ki taraf aayein.

steps.en: Hold, then relax slowly.
steps.ru: Hold karein, phir aahista relax karein.

breathing.en: Breathe slowly and relax into the stretch.
breathing.ru: Aahista saans lein aur stretch mein relax karein.

progressions: Stretch with the knee bent for soleus

say.en: Keep the knee straight and gently pull the foot towards you.
say.ru: Ghutna seedha rakhein aur paon ko aahista apni taraf kheinchein.

name.ru: Heel raise (dono paon par ungliyon par uthna)

summary.en: Standing, rise up onto your toes as high as you can, hold, then lower slowly.
summary.ru: Khare ho kar apni ungliyon par jitna ho sake uthein, hold karein, phir aahista neeche aayein.

contraindications: Acute Achilles tear
Sharp pain in the Achilles or heel
Poor balance without support

safety.en: Hold a counter or wall for balance.
safety.ru: Balance ke liye counter ya deewar pakar lein.

safety.en: Rise straight up — do not roll the ankles outwards.
safety.ru: Seedhe upar uthein — takhne bahar ki taraf na lur'hkayein.

setup.en: Stand with your feet hip-width apart, holding a counter lightly.
setup.ru: Paon kulhon ki chorai par rakh kar khare hon, counter ko halka sa pakar lein.

steps.en: Rise slowly onto your toes as high as you can.
steps.ru: Aahista apni ungliyon par jitna ho sake uthein.

steps.en: Hold for a moment at the top.
steps.ru: Upar pahonch kar thori der hold karein.

steps.en: Lower slowly, taking about 3 seconds.
steps.ru: Aahista, lagbhag 3 second mein neeche aayein.

say.en: Rise up onto your toes, then lower slowly.
say.ru: Ungliyon par uthein, phir aahista neeche aayein.

targets: Gastrocnemius and soleus; calf endurance on one leg

summary.en: Standing on one leg, rise up onto the toes, hold, then lower slowly.
summary.ru: Ek paon par khare ho kar ungliyon par uthein, hold karein, phir aahista neeche aayein.

contraindications: Sharp pain at the Achilles or heel
Poor single-leg balance without support
Acute Achilles tear

safety.en: Hold a counter lightly for balance.
safety.ru: Balance ke liye counter ko halka sa pakar lein.

setup.en: Stand on one leg beside a counter, the other foot lifted slightly behind.
setup.ru: Counter ke paas ek paon par khare hon, doosra paon thora peeche uthaya hua.

steps.en: Rise up onto the toes of the standing foot as high as you can.
steps.ru: Khade huye paon ki ungliyon par jitna ho sake uthein.

steps.en: Pause, then lower slowly over 3 seconds.
steps.ru: Rukein, phir 3 second mein aahista neeche aayein.

mistakes.en: Rolling to the outside of the foot
mistakes.ru: Paon ke bahar wale hissay par lur'hkana

mistakes.en: Using the arm to pull up

progressions: Eccentric heel drop off a step

say.en: Rise up onto your toes on one leg, then lower slowly.
say.ru: Ek paon ki ungliyon par uthein, phir aahista neeche aayein.

name.ru: Eccentric heel drop (step se heel neeche karna)

targets: Calf complex in slow lengthening contraction; Achilles tendon loading

summary.en: Rise onto the toes on a step with both feet, then lower the heel of one foot slowly below the step.
summary.ru: Step par dono paon se ungliyon par uthein, phir ek paon ki aerhi ko step se neeche aahista le jayein.

contraindications: Insertional Achilles pain — follow a modified programme (heels not below the step)
Acute Achilles rupture
Poor balance without support

safety.en: Hold a rail or wall. Use the pain-monitoring rule agreed with your physiotherapist.
safety.ru: Rail ya deewar pakar kar rakhein. Physiotherapist ke tay kiye hue dard ke qaaide par amal karein.

equipment: Step with a rail or wall beside it

setup.en: Stand with the balls of both feet on the edge of a step, heels hanging off.
setup.ru: Dono paon ke agle hissay step ke kinare par, aerhiyan hawa mein.

steps.en: Use both feet to rise up onto your toes.
steps.ru: Dono paon se ungliyon par uthein.

steps.en: Shift your weight to the exercising leg.
steps.ru: Wazan us taang par dalein jisse exercise karni hai.

steps.en: Lower the heel slowly (about 3 s) below the level of the step.
steps.ru: Aerhi ko aahista (lagbhag 3 second mein) step ke level se neeche le jayein.

steps.en: Use both feet to come back up.
steps.ru: Dono paon se wapis upar aayein.

breathing.en: Breathe out as you lower, in as you rise.
breathing.ru: Neeche aate waqt saans bahar, upar jate waqt andar.

mistakes.en: Rising on the working leg only
mistakes.ru: Sirf kaam wali taang se upar uthna

say.en: Lower the heel slowly below the step — about three seconds.
say.ru: Aerhi ko aahista step se neeche layein — lagbhag teen second.

name.ru: Toe raise (paon ke panjay upar uthana)

targets: Tibialis anterior and the other ankle dorsiflexors

summary.en: Leaning back against a wall, lift the front of both feet off the floor, hold, then lower slowly.
summary.ru: Deewar se tek laga kar dono paon ke agle hissay zameen se uthayein, hold karein, phir aahista neeche layein.

contraindications: Pain at the front of the ankle that increases
Complete foot drop needs clinical assessment first

safety.en: Keep your back against the wall and move slowly.
safety.ru: Peeth deewar se lagi rakhein aur aahista harkat karein.

setup.en: Stand with your back against a wall, heels about 30 cm from it.
setup.ru: Peeth deewar se laga kar khare hon, aerhiyan deewar se lagbhag 30 cm door.

steps.en: Keeping your heels on the floor, lift the front of both feet up.
steps.ru: Aerhiyan zameen par rakh kar dono paon ke agle hissay upar uthayein.

steps.en: Hold for a moment.
steps.ru: Thori der hold karein.

steps.en: Lower slowly.
steps.ru: Aahista neeche layein.

say.en: Keep your heels down and lift the front of your feet.
say.ru: Aerhiyan neeche rakhein aur paon ka agla hissa uthayein.

targets: Intrinsic foot muscles and toe flexors

summary.en: Sitting, use your toes to scrunch a towel towards you.
summary.ru: Baith kar apne panjon se towel ko apni taraf samaitein.

contraindications: Cramping in the foot that does not settle
Fresh forefoot fracture or surgery unless cleared

safety.en: Stop if your toes cramp — shake the foot out and rest.
safety.ru: Panjon mein cramp ho to ruk jayein — paon ko hila kar rest karein.

equipment: Small hand towel on a smooth floor

setup.en: Sit on a chair with your foot flat on a towel laid out on the floor.
setup.ru: Kursi par baithein, paon zameen par bichhe towel par sapaat.

steps.en: Curl your toes to grab the towel.
steps.ru: Panjay mor kar towel pakrein.

steps.en: Scrunch the towel towards you.
steps.ru: Towel ko apni taraf samaitein.

steps.en: Relax the toes and repeat.
steps.ru: Panjay dheele karein aur dohrayein.

say.en: Curl your toes and scrunch the towel towards you.
say.ru: Panjay modein aur towel ko apni taraf samaitein.

name.ru: Ankle eversion (band ke saath, paon bahar ghumana)

targets: Peroneus longus and brevis (ankle evertors); lateral ankle stability

summary.en: Sitting with a band around the foot, turn the sole outwards against the band, then return slowly.
summary.ru: Baith kar band paon par daalein aur talva bahar ki taraf ghumayein, band ke khilaf, phir aahista wapis.

contraindications: Acute ankle sprain with significant swelling
Sharp pain on the outside of the ankle
Peroneal tendon repair unless cleared

safety.en: Keep the movement at the ankle — the leg and knee stay still.
safety.ru: Harkat sirf takhne se karein — taang aur ghutna sakit rahein.

equipment: Resistance band anchored on the inside of your foot

setup.en: Sit with the leg supported and the band looped around the forefoot, anchored to your inner side.
setup.ru: Baithein, taang ko sahara dein, band paon ke agle hissay par aur andar ki taraf baandha hua.

steps.en: Turn the sole of your foot outwards against the band.
steps.ru: Paon ka talva band ke khilaf bahar ki taraf ghumayein.

steps.en: Hold briefly.
steps.ru: Thori der hold karein.

steps.en: Return slowly.
steps.ru: Aahista wapis aayein.

breathing.en: Breathe out as you turn the foot out.
breathing.ru: Paon bahar ghumate waqt saans bahar.

say.en: Turn the sole of the foot outwards against the band.
say.ru: Talva band ke khilaf bahar ki taraf ghumayein.

name.ru: Ankle inversion (band ke saath, paon andar ghumana)

targets: Tibialis posterior and tibialis anterior (ankle invertors)

summary.en: Sitting with a band around the foot, turn the sole inwards against the band, then return slowly.
summary.ru: Baith kar band paon par daalein aur talva andar ki taraf ghumayein, band ke khilaf, phir aahista wapis.

contraindications: Pain along the inside of the ankle that increases
Tendon repair unless cleared

safety.en: Keep the movement at the ankle only.

equipment: Resistance band anchored on the outside of your foot

setup.en: Sit with the leg supported and the band around the forefoot, anchored to your outer side.
setup.ru: Baithein, taang ko sahara dein, band paon ke agle hissay par aur bahar ki taraf baandha hua.

steps.en: Turn the sole of your foot inwards against the band.
steps.ru: Paon ka talva band ke khilaf andar ki taraf ghumayein.

steps.en: Hold briefly.
steps.ru: Thori der hold karein.

steps.en: Return slowly.
steps.ru: Aahista wapis aayein.

breathing.en: Breathe out as you turn the foot in.
breathing.ru: Paon andar ghumate waqt saans bahar.

say.en: Turn the sole of the foot inwards against the band.
say.ru: Talva band ke khilaf andar ki taraf ghumayein.

targets: Ankle and hip stabilisers; proprioception and balance

summary.en: Stand tall, lift one foot off the floor and balance on the other leg.
summary.ru: Seedhe khare ho kar ek paon zameen se uthayein aur doosre paon par balance karein.

contraindications: Severe balance impairment without supervision
Weight-bearing restrictions

safety.en: Stand next to a counter so you can steady yourself if you wobble.
safety.ru: Counter ke paas khare hon taa ke hilne par sahara le sakein.

setup.en: Stand tall next to a counter, feet hip-width apart.
setup.ru: Counter ke paas seedhe khare hon, paon kulhon ki chorai par.

steps.en: Shift your weight onto one leg.
steps.ru: Wazan ek taang par dalein.

steps.en: Lift the other foot off the floor and hold your balance.
steps.ru: Doosra paon uthayein aur balance banaye rakhein.

steps.en: Keep your hips level and eyes looking forward.
steps.ru: Kulhe barabar aur nazar samne rakhein.

breathing.ru: Poore waqt aam tareeqe se saans lein.

mistakes.en: Hip dropping on the lifted side
Leaning the trunk to the side

say.en: Shift your weight, lift one foot and hold your balance.
say.ru: Wazan shift karein, ek paon uthayein aur balance banaye rakhein.

name.ru: Ek paon par aage jhuk kar reach

targets: Hip and ankle control, hamstrings and gluteals; dynamic balance

summary.en: Balance on one leg, reach forward while the other leg moves back, then return to standing.
summary.ru: Ek paon par balance karein, doosri taang peeche jati hai jab aap aage reach karte hain, phir wapis seedhe ho jayein.

contraindications: Balance difficulty on one leg
Pain at the ankle or knee that increases
Weight-bearing restrictions

safety.en: Keep a counter within reach and a soft knee on the standing leg.
safety.ru: Counter qareeb rakhein aur khade huye paon ka ghutna halka mura rakhein.

setup.en: Stand on one leg with a soft knee, arms by your sides.
setup.ru: Ek paon par halka mura hua ghutna rakh kar khare hon, haath side mein.

steps.en: Lean forward from the hips and reach towards the floor.
steps.ru: Kulhon se aage jhukein aur zameen ki taraf reach karein.

steps.en: Let the other leg float back to balance you.
steps.ru: Doosri taang ko balance ke liye peeche jane dein.

steps.en: Use the standing leg to return to tall standing.
steps.ru: Khade huye paon ki taaqat se seedhe khare ho jayein.

breathing.en: Breathe in as you reach, out as you return.
breathing.ru: Reach karte waqt saans andar, wapis aate waqt bahar.

mistakes.ru: Khade huye paon ka ghutna lock ho jana

say.en: Reach forward as the other leg floats back.
say.ru: Aage reach karein jab doosri taang peeche jaye.

targets: Hip flexors, core and standing leg stabilisers; gait preparation

summary.en: Standing tall, lift one knee to hip height like marching, then lower with control.
summary.ru: Seedhe khare ho kar ek ghutna kulhe ki bulandi tak uthayein jaise march kar rahe hon, phir control se neeche layein.

contraindications: Balance difficulty without support
Hip flexion restrictions after surgery unless cleared

safety.en: Hold a counter if you feel unsteady.
safety.ru: Hilne ka ehsaas ho to counter pakar lein.

setup.en: Stand tall with your feet hip-width apart.
setup.ru: Paon kulhon ki chorai par rakh kar seedhe khare hon.

steps.en: Lift one knee up to hip height.
steps.ru: Ek ghutna kulhe ki bulandi tak uthayein.

steps.en: Pause and stay tall — no leaning.
steps.ru: Rukein aur seedhe rahein — jhukna nahi.

steps.en: Lower with control and change legs.
steps.ru: Control se neeche layein aur taang badlein.

breathing.en: Breathe out as you lift the knee.

say.en: Lift the knee to hip height and stay tall.
say.ru: Ghutna kulhe ki bulandi tak uthayein aur seedhe rahein.
